requirements.requirement: Synthetic cases remain synthetic; agent agreement cannot manufacture expert gold; keep unresolved criteria explicit.
Resolve current judgments and criterion versions; preserve scope and uncertainty; source-naming rejection does not establish numerical truth.
One question per independent requirement; include allowed alternatives; do not broaden a scoped negative to neighboring assertions.
Handwritten examples are provisional within that boundary; actual feature execution requires an actual entrypoint/result.
Join latest amendments by trace ID and hash; proposed questions and self-reported reviewer names do not automatically establish gold.
